# Filter Toolbar Pattern

Use this pattern for internal admin pages that need operational filtering above a list or table.

## Includes

- search field
- select filters
- optional date range
- reset / clear action
- count or summary
- page-level CTA when appropriate

## Rules

- Keep it visually connected to the table or content it controls.
- Do not scatter filters across the page.
- Keep local spacing compact and predictable.
- Prefer one canonical toolbar shape across internal list pages.

## Asset

- `assets/patterns/FilterToolbar.tsx`
